answer:
I added weekly goals to the Habit tracker's App side. `check_app` still flags 4 controls under 44 pt on the 375 px phone view. In the preview the tick circles and goal fields all look 44 px or taller, so I couldn't find which four it means. I also haven't tried the goal fields on your real data. The preview and checker only render a sample note.

- **Goals:** Walk is 5 days, Read is 4 and Stretch is 3. They're saved in the app's own data, not in the note's text.
- **Progress:** a new "Weekly goals" section sits under Today. Each habit has a bar and a count such as "2 / 5 days". Below the bar it says "N more days to go", "Goal reached", or how many days are out of reach.
- **Changing goals:** a "Change goals" section has a field for each habit (1–7 days). Changes apply as soon as you edit a field.
- **Week start:** the week runs Monday to today by default, and you can switch it to Sunday in the same section. Today is Monday, so this week's counts only include today so far.

I also made the tick circles larger and the day letters in the history grid bigger, because the checker flagged them as too small.
